title: Exploring the Acute Effects of Sedentary Behaviors on Cardiometabolic Risk in Hispanic Adolescents with Obesity: A Randomized Crossover Study.
authors: Soltero EG, Salim O, Mirabile Y, Musaad SM.
tables: Linear mixed effect examining the association between condition (active vs. passive) with energy expenditure and cardiometabolic outcomes while exploring sex and total fat % as moderators.
